description: A publisher states which definition documents it issues for which kinds. The definition itself is identified by its content; this record is how a reader tells whose it is.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.

previous.description: The identity of one signed evidence record.

proposal.description: The record these definitions were proposed in, on this chain or another. Naming it says the publisher accepted that proposal; it gives the proposal's author no authority.
